english.note: Use this mainly when someone looks pensive or appears lost in reflective thought, rather than simply saying they think a lot.

examples.english: They stood by the window, looking ruminative as they gazed outside.
examples.traditional: 佢企喺窗邊，若有所思咁望住出面。
